headline: review_mookuthi-amman-2
caption:
Mookuthi Amman 2, the critics' verdict: 3.3/10. The lowest-rated of the seven Diwali releases idly ranked. Critics say Nayanthara holds the screen, but cheap-looking VFX, a weak, overstuffed screenplay and comedy that misfires sink it. No critic rated it above 5/10. NDTV's Latha Srinivasan: "desperately needed a storytelling miracle".

Where: in theatres since 6 Nov.
Watch it if: You are a committed Nayanthara or Amman-film fan (3 reviews say she holds the screen).
Skip it if: Effects matter to you: 6 reviews call the VFX cheap-looking.

Highs: Nayanthara holds the screen · A bigger canvas and a grand look · Regina Cassandra adds some appeal
Lows: The VFX look cheap, even AI-made · A weak, overstuffed screenplay · The comedy misfires

Score: 3.3/10, the average of 9 published critic ratings converted to /10 (mean 3.3333, rounded half-up to one decimal). Highest: DT Next 5.0/10 (thereviewmonk's conversion). Lowest: Rediff 2.0/10 (thereviewmonk's conversion); Gulte 1/5. Only reviews published on or after the 6 Nov release count. idly has not watched the film; this post consolidates published reviews.

Would cheap-looking VFX keep you away from a Nayanthara film in theatres?

Sources: Reviews consolidated from DT Next, Filmfare, NDTV, Times of India, Cinema Express, India Today, Indian Express, Rediff and Gulte; unrated reviews from The Hollywood Reporter India and The Hindu. Ratings read on the outlets' pages and in the thereviewmonk and Rotten Tomatoes critics lists.
